decisions.decision: Package, validate and publish the current general template-to-beat Matching layer on a dedicated branch so matching work can resume from one reviewable baseline.
decisions.source: User direction in the current turn.
decisions.scope: Current general Matching implementation, contracts, cross-story evidence, receipts and tests; no template selection or rendering authorization.
decisions.reason: The workflow already defines the general matcher objective, mandatory contracts, provider-neutral runtime and continuation policy. This turn publishes the implementation and evidence that follow those rules.

decisions.decision: Treat Claude-authored Matching implementation as a stale baseline unless the current general matcher demonstrably depends on a specific executable or contract component; leave unrelated Claude work unchanged.
decisions.source: User correction in the current turn.
decisions.scope: Legacy or parallel Claude-authored Matching code only; Story, Data, Media and shared-registry authority remain separate inputs.
decisions.reason: This prevents a parallel implementation from being merged or refreshed merely because it exists, while preserving concrete dependencies required by the current matcher.

decisions.decision: Keep the pre-existing replacement-selection review file outside this publication package.
decisions.reason: The file is user-owned review state and is unrelated to packaging the current general matcher.
